```yaml
name: Build and Deploy Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        cache: 'npm'
    
    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        npm install -g @vuepress/cli@next
        npm install vuepress@next
    
    - name: Create Docs Directory Structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p docs/architecture
        touch docs/.vuepress/config.js
        touch docs/README.md
    
    - name: Initialize VuePress
      run: |
        cd docs
        npx vuepress@next init .
    
    - name: Create arc42 Structure
      run: |
        cd docs
        # Create arc42 sections
        mkdir -p architecture
        touch architecture/01-introduction-and-goals.md
        touch architecture/02-constraints.md
        touch architecture/03-context-and-scope.md
        touch architecture/04-solution-strategy.md
        touch architecture/05-building-block-view.md
        touch architecture/06-runtime-view.md
        touch architecture/07-deployment-view.md
        touch architecture/08-cross-cutting-concepts.md
        touch architecture/09-architecture-decisions.md
        touch architecture/10-quality-requirements.md
        touch architecture/11-risks-and-technical-debt.md
        touch architecture/12-glossary.md
        
        # Create README with placeholder content
        cat > README.md << EOF
# Architecture Documentation

This documentation follows the [arc42](https://arc42.org) template for documenting the system architecture.

## Sections

- [Introduction and Goals](./architecture/01-introduction-and-goals.md)
- [Constraints](./architecture/02-constraints.md)
- [Context and Scope](./architecture/03-context-and-scope.md)
- [Solution Strategy](./architecture/04-solution-strategy.md)
- [Building Block View](./architecture/05-building-block-view.md)
- [Runtime View](./architecture/06-runtime-view.md)
- [Deployment View](./architecture/07-deployment-view.md)
- [Cross-cutting Concepts](./architecture/08-cross-cutting-concepts.md)
- [Architecture Decisions](./architecture/09-architecture-decisions.md)
- [Quality Requirements](./architecture/10-quality-requirements.md)
- [Risks and Technical Debt](./architecture/11-risks-and-technical-debt.md)
- [Glossary](./architecture/12-glossary.md)
EOF
    
    - name: Configure VuePress
      run: |
        cd docs
        cat > .vuepress/config.js << EOF
module.exports = {
  title: 'BookWorm Architecture',
  description: 'Architecture documentation for BookWorm project',
  base: '/BookWorm/',
  themeConfig: {
    nav: [
      { text: 'Home', link: '/' },
      { text: 'Architecture', link: '/architecture/' }
    ],
    sidebar: [
      '/',
      {
        title: 'Architecture Documentation',
        collapsable: false,
        children: [
          '/architecture/01-introduction-and-goals',
          '/architecture/02-constraints',
          '/architecture/03-context-and-scope',
          '/architecture/04-solution-strategy',
          '/architecture/05-building-block-view',
          '/architecture/06-runtime-view',
          '/architecture/07-deployment-view',
          '/architecture/08-cross-cutting-concepts',
          '/architecture/09-architecture-decisions',
          '/architecture/10-quality-requirements',
          '/architecture/11-risks-and-technical-debt',
          '/architecture/12-glossary'
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
    
    - name: Build Documentation
      run: |
        cd docs
        npm run docs:build
    
    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs/.vuepress/dist
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        commit_message: 'Deploy documentation'
```
